title: Explain Your Group Budget
instructions: Write your own first draft using your own details. Do not copy the speaking example.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend about a fictional group meal. Give a budget and prices for at least three purchases, explain the quantities, calculate the total and remaining amount, and describe how you will check payment. Use at least six different lesson words and both how much and how many.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Write four parts: budget and purpose; countable and uncountable quantities; prices and total; payment and money remaining. Check that the arithmetic is consistent.
